description: Machine-to-machine request for adversarial behavioral verification of an agent skill / MCP server. POST to /v1/quote.

callback.description: Where to deliver completion. Webhook POST on job completion with the job id and manifest URL.

secret.description: Optional shared secret; webhook POSTs carry it in X-Skillproof-Secret for authentication.

contact.description: Who is requesting. Agents identify themselves; no human account needed.

agent_id.description: Stable identifier for the requesting agent / organization.

target.description: The exact artifact to verify. Must be installable without human help.

code_hash.description: Optional client-computed sha256 of the artifact. The manifest will carry the verifier's own computed hash; a mismatch is reported as a finding.

commit.description: Optional commit hash when verifying from source rather than a published package.

install_command.description: Optional explicit install command, e.g. 'npm i -g pkg@0.6.3'. Overrides the default derived from package/version.

package.description: Package identifier, e.g. npm package name or PyPI name.

transport.description: How the server is launched / reached.

version.description: Pinned version that will be executed and bound into the manifest.

tier.description: Service tier. See /.well-known/skillproof.json for prices and SLAs.

title: SkillProof verification request
